purpose: refine warranted conclusions, not maximize an effect

A.round1: balanced five-work coverage; leave-one-section-out prediction of pair ranks for existing raw and lexical trigram Jaccard
A.round2: remove sections 21 and 29; leave-numbered-family-out; within-section author-label permutation, 1000 repeats, fixed seed 112; report weak/null and strong results

B.round1: 29 KST/Ricanati comparisons: subtract all corpus Ramban 5-grams, merge overlapping matched spans, retain lengths and exact offsets
B.round2: remove 21/29, remove sequences present in any third work label (excluding KST witness L); compare normalization and multiple n lengths; distinguish graph raw peaks from verbal-reuse peaks

C.round1: all shared IbnShuib/KST/base sections, matched by section: base coverage, text coverage, order anchors, observable metacommentary markers
C.round2: exclude previously read cases; inspect marker contexts for false attribution and compare all five authors; refrain from equating length or quotation with authority

D.round1: equal-coverage lexical network strength, paired blocks and explicit reception kept separate; broaden authority mention search and inspect context
D.round2: remove explicit reception sections and KST/Ricanati peaks from lexical centrality; compare manuscript branches from full scholarly article without treating witnesses as independent intellectual recipients

stop_rule: two rounds plus targeted error/counterexample check per question; stop when further discrimination needs unavailable witnesses/full works or independent scholarly coding; document executable next test
provenance: base research v1.0 immutable; derived dataset version 11.2; no edits to source texts or original raw measures
